questions.text: Which of the following UML 2.0 diagrams capture behavioral aspects of a system?
questions.solution:
Behavioural diagrams show what the system does: use case, activity and state machine diagrams (plus interaction diagrams). Object, package, deployment and composite structure diagrams are structural.

Answer: Use case diagram, Activity diagram and state machine diagram

questions.text: Estimation at software development effort for organic software in basic COCOMO is:
questions.solution:
Basic COCOMO, organic mode: [latex]E=2.4(KLOC)^{1.05}[/latex] person-months. (Semi-detached: 3.0, 1.12; embedded: 3.6, 1.20.)

Answer: [latex]E=2.4(KLOC)^{1.05}[/latex]

questions.text: In the Spiral model of software development, the primary determinant in selecting activities in each iteration is
questions.solution:
The spiral model is risk-driven: each loop starts by identifying and resolving the biggest risks, which decides what to do in that iteration.

Answer: Risk

questions.text: A company needs to develop a digital signal processing software for one of its newest inventions. The software is expected to have 20000 lines of code. The company needs to determine the effort in person-months needed to develop this software using the basic COCOMO model. The multiplicative factor for this model is given as 2.2 for the software development on embedded systems, while the exponentiation factor is given as 1.5. What is the estimated effort in person-months?
questions.solution:
Basic COCOMO: Effort = a [latex]\times[/latex] (KLOC)[latex]^b[/latex] = [latex]2.2\times20^{1.5}[/latex].

[latex]20^{1.5}=20\sqrt{20}\approx89.44[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]2.2\times89.44\approx196.77[/latex] person-months

Answer: 196.77

questions.text:
A company needs to develop a strategy for software product development for which it has a choice of two programming languages L1 and L2. The number lines of code (LOC) developed using L2 is estimated to be twice of the LOC developed with L1. The product will have to be maintained for five years. Various parameters for the company are given in the table below.
[latex]\begin{array}{|l|l|l|} \hline \text{Parameter} & \text{Language L1} & \text{Language L2} \\ \hline \text{Man years needed for development} & LOC/10000 & LOC/10000 \\ \hline \text{Development Cost per man year} & Rs. 10, 00, 000 & Rs. 7, 50, 000 \\ \hline \text{Maintenance Time} & \text{5 years} & \text{5 years} \\ \hline \text{Cost of maintenance per year} & Rs.\; 1,00,000 & Rs. \; 50, 000 \\ \hline \end{array}[/latex]
Total cost of the project includes cost of development and maintenance. What is the LOC for L1 for which of the cost of the project using L1 is equal to the cost of the project using L2?
questions.solution:
Let L1 need x lines; L2 needs 2x.
- L1 cost = [latex]\frac{x}{10000}\times10{,}00{,}000+5\times1{,}00{,}000=100x+5{,}00{,}000[/latex]
- L2 cost = [latex]\frac{2x}{10000}\times7{,}50{,}000+5\times50{,}000=150x+2{,}50{,}000[/latex]

Equal: [latex]50x=2{,}50{,}000\Rightarrow x=5000[/latex]

Answer: 5000
